dedupe_keys.name: rri rainfall runoff inundation model of icharm

description: The RRI model simulates rainfall-runoff, river discharge and inundation over floodplains in one integrated basin model, developed to predict large-scale inundation in low-lying areas quickly. ICHARM produced it and has released it free on its website since May 2016; it won the Japan Society of Civil Engineers paper award in 2014. With satellite topography, land use and rainfall it can estimate large floods worldwide in near real time, and ICHARM expects it to help assess how flood risk changes under climate projections. Coverage is any river basin with terrain and rainfall input; an RRI-GUI (beta 1.4.2.7) adds Japanese flow direction, land use and radar rainfall data and fast watershed extraction for real-time forecasting of small and medium rivers. Caveats: the page names no licence, and the GUI with domestic data is a beta for Japan. Simulation uses: basin-scale flood inundation for hazard mapping, flood forecasting and climate adaptation of flood defences. Related records: LISFLOOD-FP (model-lisflood-fp) and HEC-RAS (model-hec-ras).
